CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.admin_list_users()
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, email text, is_active boolean, created_at timestamp with time zone, balance_usdt numeric, balance_irr numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is null or not private.is_super_admin() then
    raise exception 'Super administrator access required' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  return query
    select p.id, p.email, p.is_active, p.created_at,
           coalesce(w.balance_usdt, 0), coalesce(w.balance_irr, 0)
    from public.profiles p
    left join public.wallets w on w.user_id = p.id
    order by p.created_at desc nulls last, p.id;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.auto_activate_verified_exchange_pairs()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_inserted integer := 0;
BEGIN
  WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
      ca.coingecko_id,
      pg_catalog.upper(ca.symbol) || 'USDT' AS pair_symbol
    FROM public.crypto_assets AS ca
    JOIN public.admin_market_listings AS l
      ON l.coingecko_id = ca.coingecko_id
    JOIN public.market_prices AS mp
      ON mp.symbol = pg_catalog.upper(ca.symbol) || 'USDT'
    WHERE ca.is_active IS TRUE
      AND ca.symbol ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{2,15}$'
      AND pg_catalog.upper(ca.symbol) <> 'USDT'
      AND ca.current_price_usd > 0
      AND ca.last_updated >= pg_catalog.now() - interval '24 hours'
      AND ca.total_volume_usd >= 1000000
      AND (ca.market_cap_rank IS NULL OR ca.market_cap_rank <= 2000)
      AND mp.price > 0
      AND mp.source = 'CoinGecko'
      AND mp.updated_at >= pg_catalog.now() - interval '2 minutes'
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.exchange_asset_observations AS o
        WHERE o.coingecko_id = ca.coingecko_id
          AND o.match_status = 'matched'
          AND o.is_active IS TRUE
          AND o.last_seen_at >= pg_catalog.now() - interval '48 hours'
      )
      AND (
        SELECT pg_catalog.count(*)
        FROM public.crypto_assets AS other
        WHERE other.is_active IS TRUE
          AND pg_catalog.upper(other.symbol) = pg_catalog.upper(ca.symbol)
      ) = 1
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.demo_trading_pairs AS conflict
        WHERE conflict.pair_symbol = pg_catalog.upper(ca.symbol) || 'USDT'
          AND conflict.base_coingecko_id <> ca.coingecko_id
      )
  )
  INSERT INTO public.demo_trading_pairs(
    pair_symbol, base_coingecko_id, quote_asset, is_enabled, created_at, updated_at
  )
  SELECT pair_symbol, coingecko_id, 'USDT', true, pg_catalog.now(), pg_catalog.now()
  FROM eligible
  ON CONFLICT (pair_symbol) DO NOTHING;

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_inserted = ROW_COUNT;

  RETURN pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'activated_pairs', v_inserted,
    'checked_at', pg_catalog.now(),
    'policy', 'automatic_verified_exchange_listing'
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.auto_list_verified_exchange_asset()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 if new.match_status='matched'
    and new.is_active is true
    and new.coingecko_id is not null
    and (
      tg_op='INSERT'
      or old.match_status is distinct from new.match_status
      or old.coingecko_id is distinct from new.coingecko_id
      or old.is_active is distinct from new.is_active
    )
 then
  insert into public.admin_market_listings(coingecko_id,added_by)
  select ca.coingecko_id,null::uuid from public.crypto_assets ca
  where ca.coingecko_id=new.coingecko_id and ca.is_active is true
    and ca.current_price_usd>0 and ca.last_updated>=now()-interval '24 hours'
    and (select count(*) from public.crypto_assets c2 where c2.is_active is true and upper(c2.symbol)=upper(ca.symbol))=1
    and not exists(select 1 from public.admin_market_listings l join public.crypto_assets c2 using(coingecko_id) where upper(c2.symbol)=upper(ca.symbol) and l.coingecko_id<>ca.coingecko_id)
    and not exists(select 1 from public.demo_trading_pairs dp where dp.pair_symbol=upper(ca.symbol)||'USDT' and dp.base_coingecko_id<>ca.coingecko_id)
  on conflict(coingecko_id) do nothing;
 end if;
 return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_exchange_asset_sync_report()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare result jsonb;
begin
  if not private.is_current_user_super_admin() then
    raise exception 'دسترسی مدیر ارشد لازم است' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'summary', jsonb_build_object(
      'observations', (select count(*) from public.exchange_asset_observations),
      'exchanges', (select count(distinct exchange) from public.exchange_asset_observations where is_active),
      'symbols', (select count(distinct base_symbol) from public.exchange_asset_observations where is_active),
      'matched', (select count(*) from public.exchange_asset_observations where is_active and match_status='matched'),
      'ambiguous', (select count(*) from public.exchange_asset_observations where is_active and match_status='ambiguous'),
      'pending', (select count(*) from public.exchange_asset_observations where is_active and match_status='pending'),
      'unmatched', (select count(*) from public.exchange_asset_observations where is_active and match_status='unmatched'),
      'listed', (select count(*) from public.admin_market_listings)
    ),
    'sources', (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(s) order by s.exchange), '[]'::jsonb)
      from (
        select e.exchange,
          coalesce(o.active_markets,0) as active_markets,
          o.last_seen_at,
          r.last_requested_at,
          r.last_processed_at,
          r.http_status,
          r.error_message
        from (values ('nobitex'),('wallex'),('tabdeal'),('ompfinex'),('exir'),('abantether'),('bit24')) e(exchange)
        left join lateral (
          select count(*) filter(where is_active) as active_markets, max(last_seen_at) as last_seen_at
          from public.exchange_asset_observations x where x.exchange=e.exchange
        ) o on true
        left join lateral (
          select max(requested_at) as last_requested_at, max(processed_at) as last_processed_at,
            (array_agg(http_status order by requested_at desc))[1] as http_status,
            (array_agg(error_message order by requested_at desc))[1] as error_message
          from (
            select requested_at, processed_at, http_status, error_message
            from public.exchange_asset_sync_requests where exchange=e.exchange
            union all
            select requested_at, processed_at, http_status, error_message
            from public.bit24_exchange_sync_requests where e.exchange='bit24'
          ) z
        ) r on true
      ) s
    ),
    'issues', (
      select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i) order by i.exchange, i.base_symbol), '[]'::jsonb)
      from (
        select exchange, base_symbol, asset_name, market_symbol, match_status, coingecko_id, last_seen_at
        from public.exchange_asset_observations
        where is_active and match_status in ('ambiguous','pending','unmatched')
        order by case match_status when 'ambiguous' then 1 when 'pending' then 2 else 3 end, last_seen_at desc
        limit 100
      ) i
    )
  ) into result;
  return result;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_review_market_listings()
 RETURNS TABLE(coingecko_id text, symbol text, name text, pair_symbol text, current_price_usd numeric, total_volume_usd numeric, market_cap_rank integer, metadata_updated_at timestamp with time zone, market_price numeric, price_source text, price_updated_at timestamp with time zone, price_age_seconds numeric, is_enabled boolean, is_eligible boolean, eligibility_reason text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  WITH rows AS (
    SELECT
      ca.coingecko_id,
      ca.symbol,
      ca.name,
      pg_catalog.upper(ca.symbol) || 'USDT' AS pair_symbol,
      ca.current_price_usd,
      ca.total_volume_usd,
      ca.market_cap_rank,
      ca.last_updated AS metadata_updated_at,
      mp.price AS market_price,
      mp.source AS price_source,
      mp.updated_at AS price_updated_at,
      CASE WHEN mp.updated_at IS NULL THEN NULL
           ELSE EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (pg_catalog.now() - mp.updated_at)) END AS price_age_seconds,
      COALESCE(dp.is_enabled, false) AS is_enabled,
      ca.is_active,
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.demo_trading_pairs AS other
        WHERE other.pair_symbol = pg_catalog.upper(ca.symbol) || 'USDT'
          AND other.base_coingecko_id <> ca.coingecko_id
      ) AS symbol_conflict
    FROM public.admin_market_listings AS l
    JOIN public.crypto_assets AS ca ON ca.coingecko_id = l.coingecko_id
    LEFT JOIN public.market_prices AS mp
      ON mp.symbol = pg_catalog.upper(ca.symbol) || 'USDT'
    LEFT JOIN public.demo_trading_pairs AS dp
      ON dp.base_coingecko_id = ca.coingecko_id
  )
  SELECT
    x.coingecko_id, x.symbol, x.name, x.pair_symbol,
    x.current_price_usd, x.total_volume_usd, x.market_cap_rank,
    x.metadata_updated_at, x.market_price, x.price_source,
    x.price_updated_at, x.price_age_seconds, x.is_enabled,
    (
      x.is_active IS TRUE
      AND x.symbol ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{2,15}$'
      AND pg_catalog.upper(x.symbol) <> 'USDT'
      AND x.current_price_usd > 0
      AND x.metadata_updated_at >= pg_catalog.now() - interval '24 hours'
      AND x.total_volume_usd >= 1000000
      AND (x.market_cap_rank IS NULL OR x.market_cap_rank <= 2000)
      AND x.market_price > 0
      AND x.price_source = 'CoinGecko'
      AND x.price_updated_at >= pg_catalog.now() - interval '2 minutes'
      AND NOT x.symbol_conflict
    ) AS is_eligible,
    CASE
      WHEN x.is_active IS NOT TRUE THEN 'ارز در کاتالوگ غیرفعال است'
      WHEN x.symbol !~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{2,15}$' OR pg_catalog.upper(x.symbol) = 'USDT' THEN 'نماد ارز برای جفت USDT معتبر نیست'
      WHEN x.current_price_usd IS NULL OR x.current_price_usd <= 0 THEN 'قیمت مرجع معتبر نیست'
      WHEN x.metadata_updated_at IS NULL OR x.metadata_updated_at < pg_catalog.now() - interval '24 hours' THEN 'اطلاعات بازار ارز قدیمی‌تر از ۲۴ ساعت است'
      WHEN x.total_volume_usd IS NULL OR x.total_volume_usd < 1000000 THEN 'حجم معاملات ۲۴ساعته کمتر از یک میلیون دلار است'
      WHEN x.market_cap_rank IS NOT NULL AND x.market_cap_rank > 2000 THEN 'رتبه ارزش بازار خارج از محدوده مجاز است'
      WHEN x.market_price IS NULL OR x.market_price <= 0 THEN 'هنوز قیمت زنده برای این جفت‌ارز دریافت نشده است'
      WHEN x.price_source <> 'CoinGecko' THEN 'منبع قیمت تأیید نشده است'
      WHEN x.price_updated_at IS NULL OR x.price_updated_at < pg_catalog.now() - interval '2 minutes' THEN 'قیمت زنده قدیمی‌تر از دو دقیقه است'
      WHEN x.symbol_conflict THEN 'نماد این جفت‌ارز با دارایی دیگری تداخل دارد'
      ELSE 'آماده فعال‌سازی'
    END AS eligibility_reason
  FROM rows AS x
  WHERE auth.uid() IS NOT NULL
    AND private.is_super_admin()
  ORDER BY x.metadata_updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, x.symbol;
$function$
functions.result_type: TABLE(coingecko_id text, symbol text, name text, pair_symbol text, current_price_usd numeric, total_volume_usd numeric, market_cap_rank integer, metadata_updated_at timestamp with time zone, market_price numeric, price_source text, price_updated_at timestamp with time zone, price_age_seconds numeric, is_enabled boolean, is_eligible boolean, eligibility_reason text)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.admin_search_market_assets(p_search text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS TABLE(coingecko_id text, symbol text, name text, image_url text, market_cap_rank integer, current_price_usd numeric, last_updated timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_search text := pg_catalog.btrim(COALESCE(p_search, ''));
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT private.is_super_admin() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Super administrator access required' USING errcode = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF pg_catalog.length(v_search) < 2 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Search query must contain at least two characters';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT ca.coingecko_id, ca.symbol, ca.name, ca.image_url,
         ca.market_cap_rank, ca.current_price_usd, ca.last_updated
  FROM public.crypto_assets AS ca
  WHERE ca.is_active IS TRUE
    AND (
      ca.symbol ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'
      OR ca.name ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'
      OR ca.coingecko_id ILIKE '%' || v_search || '%'
    )
  ORDER BY ca.market_cap_rank ASC NULLS LAST
  LIMIT LEAST(GREATEST(COALESCE(p_limit, 20), 1), 50);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_admin_market_listings()
 RETURNS TABLE(coingecko_id text, symbol text, name text, image_url text, market_cap_rank integer, current_price_usd numeric, price_toman numeric, price_change_percentage_24h numeric, total_volume_usd numeric, last_updated timestamp with time zone, added_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT
    ca.coingecko_id,
    ca.symbol,
    ca.name,
    ca.image_url,
    ca.market_cap_rank,
    CASE
      WHEN mp.updated_at >= pg_catalog.now() - interval '2 minutes'
       AND mp.source = 'CoinGecko'
       AND mp.price > 0
      THEN mp.price
      ELSE NULL
    END AS current_price_usd,
    ca.price_toman,
    ca.price_change_percentage_24h,
    ca.total_volume_usd,
    mp.updated_at AS last_updated,
    l.created_at AS added_at
  FROM public.admin_market_listings AS l
  JOIN public.crypto_assets AS ca ON ca.coingecko_id = l.coingecko_id
  LEFT JOIN public.market_prices AS mp
    ON mp.symbol = pg_catalog.upper(ca.symbol) || 'USDT'
  WHERE ca.is_active IS TRUE
  ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, ca.market_cap_rank ASC NULLS LAST;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_exchange_discovered_market_assets()
 RETURNS TABLE(symbol text, name text, current_price_usd numeric, last_updated timestamp with time zone, exchange_sources text, exchange_count integer, observed_at timestamp with time zone, match_status text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  WITH active_observations AS (
    SELECT upper(o.base_symbol) AS symbol,
           nullif(btrim(o.asset_name), '') AS asset_name,
           o.exchange, o.last_seen_at, o.match_status
    FROM public.exchange_asset_observations AS o
    WHERE o.is_active IS TRUE
      AND o.base_symbol ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{2,20}$'
      AND o.last_seen_at >= pg_catalog.now() - interval '48 hours'
      AND o.match_status IN ('pending', 'ambiguous', 'unmatched')
      AND coalesce(o.asset_name, '') !~* '(stock|equity|shares|xstock|tokenized)'
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.admin_market_listings AS l
        JOIN public.crypto_assets AS ca ON ca.coingecko_id = l.coingecko_id
        WHERE upper(ca.symbol) = upper(o.base_symbol)
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.demo_trading_pairs AS dp
        JOIN public.crypto_assets AS ca ON ca.coingecko_id = dp.base_coingecko_id
        WHERE upper(ca.symbol) = upper(o.base_symbol)
          AND dp.is_enabled IS TRUE
      )
  ),
  grouped AS (
    SELECT symbol,
           (array_agg(asset_name ORDER BY last_seen_at DESC)
             FILTER (WHERE asset_name IS NOT NULL))[1] AS name,
           array_to_string(array_agg(DISTINCT exchange ORDER BY exchange), ', ') AS exchange_sources,
           count(DISTINCT exchange)::integer AS exchange_count,
           max(last_seen_at) AS observed_at,
           CASE WHEN bool_or(match_status = 'ambiguous') THEN 'ambiguous' ELSE 'unmatched' END AS match_status
    FROM active_observations
    GROUP BY symbol
  )
  SELECT g.symbol,
         coalesce(g.name, g.symbol) AS name,
         mp.price AS current_price_usd,
         mp.updated_at AS last_updated,
         g.exchange_sources,
         g.exchange_count,
         g.observed_at,
         g.match_status
  FROM grouped AS g
  LEFT JOIN public.market_prices AS mp
    ON mp.symbol = g.symbol || 'USDT'
   AND mp.price > 0
   AND mp.updated_at >= pg_catalog.now() - interval '2 minutes'
  ORDER BY g.observed_at DESC, g.symbol;
$function$
functions.result_type: TABLE(symbol text, name text, current_price_usd numeric, last_updated timestamp with time zone, exchange_sources text, exchange_count integer, observed_at timestamp with time zone, match_status text)
functions.dependency_method: pg_depend direct catalog references only; PL/pgSQL body references may not be recorded

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.process_bit24_exchange_sync()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare n integer:=0; p integer:=0;
begin
 with resp as (
  select q.request_id,r.content::jsonb j from public.bit24_exchange_sync_requests q
  join net._http_response r on r.id=q.request_id
  where q.processed_at is null and r.status_code=200 and r.content is not null
 ), rows as (
  select upper(replace(x->>'market_name','/','_')) market_symbol,
   upper(x->'base_coin'->>'symbol') base_symbol,
   upper(x->'quote_coin'->>'symbol') quote_symbol,
   x->'base_coin'->>'name' asset_name,x
  from resp r cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(r.j->'data'->'results') x
  where x->'base_coin'->>'symbol' is not null and x->>'market_name' is not null
 )
 insert into public.exchange_asset_observations(exchange,market_symbol,base_symbol,quote_symbol,asset_name,source_url,source_payload,is_active,last_seen_at)
 select 'bit24',market_symbol,base_symbol,quote_symbol,asset_name,'https://pro.bit24.cash/api/v3/markets',x,true,now()
 from rows
 on conflict(exchange,market_symbol) do update set base_symbol=excluded.base_symbol,quote_symbol=excluded.quote_symbol,
 asset_name=coalesce(excluded.asset_name,public.exchange_asset_observations.asset_name),
 source_payload=excluded.source_payload,is_active=excluded.is_active,last_seen_at=now()
 WHERE public.exchange_asset_observations.base_symbol IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.base_symbol
    OR public.exchange_asset_observations.quote_symbol IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.quote_symbol
    OR public.exchange_asset_observations.asset_name IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(EXCLUDED.asset_name,public.exchange_asset_observations.asset_name)
    OR public.exchange_asset_observations.source_payload IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.source_payload
    OR public.exchange_asset_observations.is_active IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.is_active
    OR public.exchange_asset_observations.last_seen_at IS NULL
    OR public.exchange_asset_observations.last_seen_at < now() - interval '30 minutes';
 get diagnostics n=row_count;
 update public.bit24_exchange_sync_requests q set processed_at=now(),http_status=r.status_code,error_message=left(r.error_msg,500)
 from net._http_response r where r.id=q.request_id and q.processed_at is null;
 get diagnostics p=row_count;
 with candidates as (
  select o.id,ca.coingecko_id,count(ca.coingecko_id) over(partition by o.id) candidate_count
  from public.exchange_asset_observations o join public.crypto_assets ca on upper(ca.symbol)=upper(o.base_symbol) and ca.is_active is true
  where o.exchange='bit24' and o.is_active is true and o.asset_name is not null and (
   regexp_replace(lower(o.asset_name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')=regexp_replace(lower(ca.name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')
   or (length(regexp_replace(lower(o.asset_name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g'))>=5 and length(regexp_replace(lower(ca.name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g'))>=5
   and (regexp_replace(lower(o.asset_name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g') like '%'||regexp_replace(lower(ca.name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')||'%'
   or regexp_replace(lower(ca.name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g') like '%'||regexp_replace(lower(o.asset_name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')||'%'))
  )
 ), chosen as (select id,min(coingecko_id) filter(where candidate_count=1) coingecko_id,max(candidate_count) candidate_count from candidates group by id)
 update public.exchange_asset_observations o set coingecko_id=c.coingecko_id,
 match_status=case when c.candidate_count=1 then 'matched' when c.candidate_count>1 then 'ambiguous' else 'pending' end
 from chosen c where o.id=c.id
 and (
  o.coingecko_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.coingecko_id
  OR o.match_status IS DISTINCT FROM CASE
   WHEN c.candidate_count=1 THEN 'matched'
   WHEN c.candidate_count>1 THEN 'ambiguous'
   ELSE 'pending'
  END
 );
 update public.exchange_asset_observations o set coingecko_id=null,match_status='unmatched'
 where o.exchange='bit24' and o.is_active is true and o.asset_name is not null
 and not exists(select 1 from public.crypto_assets ca where upper(ca.symbol)=upper(o.base_symbol) and ca.is_active is true)
 and (o.coingecko_id is not null or o.match_status is distinct from 'unmatched');
 return jsonb_build_object('processed_requests',p,'upserted_rows',n);
end; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.process_iran_exchange_asset_sync()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare v_ingested integer := 0; v_processed integer := 0;
begin
 with resp as (
  select q.exchange,q.request_id,private.try_parse_jsonb(r.content) j,r.status_code,r.error_msg
  from public.exchange_asset_sync_requests q join net._http_response r on r.id=q.request_id
  where q.processed_at is null and r.status_code=200 and r.content is not null and private.try_parse_jsonb(r.content) is not null
 ), rows as (
  select 'nobitex'::text exchange,upper(x->>'coin') market_symbol,upper(x->>'coin') base_symbol,null::text quote_symbol,x->>'name' asset_name,'https://apiv2.nobitex.ir/v2/options'::text source_url,x source_payload,true is_active
  from resp r cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(r.j->'coins') x where r.exchange='nobitex' and x->>'coin' is not null
  union all
  select 'wallex',e.key,upper(e.value->>'baseAsset'),upper(e.value->>'quoteAsset'),coalesce(e.value->>'enBaseAsset',e.value->>'faBaseAsset'),'https://api.wallex.ir/v1/markets',e.value,true
  from resp r cross join lateral jsonb_each(r.j->'result'->'symbols') e where r.exchange='wallex'
  union all
  select 'tabdeal',upper(e.key||'_'||q.key),upper(e.key),upper(q.key),e.key,'https://api-web.tabdeal.org/r/plots/currencies/dynamic-info/',q.value,true
  from resp r cross join lateral jsonb_each(r.j->'currencies') e cross join lateral jsonb_each(e.value) q where r.exchange='tabdeal'
  union all
  select 'ompfinex',upper(x->>'symbol'),upper(x->>'baseCurrencyId'),upper(x->>'quoteCurrencyId'),null::text,'https://api.ompfinex.com/v2/market',x,coalesce(x->>'status'='LISTED',true)
  from resp r cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(r.j->'data') x where r.exchange='ompfinex' and x->>'baseCurrencyId' is not null
  union all
  select 'exir',upper(e.key),upper(split_part(e.key,'-',1)),upper(split_part(e.key,'-',2)),split_part(e.key,'-',1),'https://api.exir.io/v2/ticker/all',e.value,true
  from resp r cross join lateral jsonb_each(r.j) e where r.exchange='exir' and position('-' in e.key)>0
  union all
  select 'abantether',upper(x->>'symbol'),upper(x->>'symbol'),null::text,x->>'name','https://api.abantether.ir/api/v2/manager/coins',x,coalesce((x->>'is_active')::boolean,true)
  from resp r cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(r.j->'data') x where r.exchange='abantether' and x->>'coin_type'='COIN'
  union all
  select 'kifpool',upper(x->>'symbol'),upper(x->>'symbol'),'IRT'::text,coalesce(x->>'name',x->>'title'),'https://kifpool.me/api/graphql',x,true
  from resp r cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(r.j->'data'->'coinList'->'coins') x
  where r.exchange='kifpool' and r.j->'errors' is null and coalesce(x->>'symbol','') ~ '^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,19}$'
 )
 insert into public.exchange_asset_observations(exchange,market_symbol,base_symbol,quote_symbol,asset_name,source_url,source_payload,is_active,last_seen_at)
 select d.exchange,d.market_symbol,d.base_symbol,d.quote_symbol,d.asset_name,d.source_url,d.source_payload,d.is_active,now()
 from (
  select distinct on (exchange,market_symbol) exchange,market_symbol,base_symbol,quote_symbol,asset_name,source_url,source_payload,is_active
  from rows where market_symbol is not null and base_symbol is not null
  order by exchange,market_symbol,(asset_name is not null) desc
 ) d
 on conflict(exchange,market_symbol) do update set base_symbol=excluded.base_symbol,quote_symbol=excluded.quote_symbol,
 asset_name=coalesce(excluded.asset_name,public.exchange_asset_observations.asset_name),source_payload=excluded.source_payload,is_active=excluded.is_active,last_seen_at=now()
 WHERE public.exchange_asset_observations.base_symbol IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.base_symbol
    OR public.exchange_asset_observations.quote_symbol IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.quote_symbol
    OR public.exchange_asset_observations.asset_name IS DISTINCT FROM COALESCE(EXCLUDED.asset_name,public.exchange_asset_observations.asset_name)
    OR public.exchange_asset_observations.source_payload IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.source_payload
    OR public.exchange_asset_observations.is_active IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.is_active
    OR public.exchange_asset_observations.last_seen_at IS NULL
    OR public.exchange_asset_observations.last_seen_at < now() - interval '30 minutes';
 get diagnostics v_ingested=row_count;
 update public.exchange_asset_sync_requests q set processed_at=now(),http_status=r.status_code,error_message=case when r.status_code=200 and private.try_parse_jsonb(r.content) is null then 'Invalid JSON response; skipped safely and will retry on next scheduled sync' else left(r.error_msg,500) end
 from net._http_response r where r.id=q.request_id and q.processed_at is null;
 get diagnostics v_processed=row_count;
 with kifpool_exact as (
  select o.id,ca.coingecko_id
  from public.exchange_asset_observations o join public.crypto_assets ca
   on ca.is_active is true
   and upper(ca.symbol)=upper(o.base_symbol)
   and (
    (
     ca.coingecko_id=o.source_payload->>'nameId'
     and (
      regexp_replace(lower(o.asset_name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')=regexp_replace(lower(ca.name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')
      or exists (
       select 1
       from (values
        ('adex','adex','heyaura'),
        ('crypto-com-chain','cryptocomcoin','cronos'),
        ('elrond-erd-2','elrond','multiversx'),
        ('blockstack','blockstack','stacks'),
        ('the-open-network','gram','gramprevtoncoin'),
        ('frax','frax','legacyfraxdollar'),
        ('kishu-inu','kishu','kishuinu'),
        ('centrifuge','centrifuge','centrifugeold'),
        ('jupiter','jupiter','jupiterproject'),
        ('apriori','apriori','capricorn'),
        ('avantis','avantis','veranta'),
        ('assemble-protocol','assembleprotocol','assembleai'),
        ('certik','certik','shentu'),
        ('everdome','everdome','humainweb3'),
        ('ankr','ankr','ankrnetwork'),
        ('band-protocol','bandprotocol','band'),
        ('binancecoin','binancecoin','bnb'),
        ('superfarm','superfarm','superverse'),
        ('busy-dao','busydao','busy'),
        ('dtec-token','dtec','dtectoken'),
        ('dusk-network','dusknetwork','dusk'),
        ('farcana','farcana','farlabs'),
        ('ftx-token','ftxtoken','ftx'),
        ('gme','gmeonsol','gme'),
        ('gamee','gmee','gamee'),
        ('stepn','stepn','gmt'),
        ('mx-token','mxtoken','mx'),
        ('nodecoin','nodecoin','nodepay'),
        ('near','near','nearprotocol'),
        ('apenft','apenft','ainft'),
        ('noot-noot','noot','nootnoot'),
        ('origin-protocol','originprotocol','origintoken'),
        ('ondo-finance','ondofinance','ondo'),
        ('subsquid','subsquid','sqd'),
        ('tokocrypto','tokotoken','tokocrypto'),
        ('usd-coin','usdcoin','usdc'),
        ('vapor-wallet','vaporwallet','vaporfund'),
        ('zignaly','zignaly','zigfinance'),
        ('0x','0x','0xprotocol')
       ) as aliases(coingecko_id,legacy_name,current_name)
       where aliases.coingecko_id=ca.coingecko_id
        and aliases.legacy_name=regexp_replace(lower(o.asset_name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')
        and aliases.current_name=regexp_replace(lower(ca.name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')
      )
     )
    )
    or exists (
     select 1
     from (values
      ('arpa-chain','arpa','arpachain','arpa')
     ) as legacy_ids(source_id,coingecko_id,legacy_name,current_name)
     where legacy_ids.source_id=o.source_payload->>'nameId'
      and legacy_ids.coingecko_id=ca.coingecko_id
      and legacy_ids.legacy_name=regexp_replace(lower(o.asset_name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')
      and legacy_ids.current_name=regexp_replace(lower(ca.name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')
    )
   )
  where o.exchange='kifpool' and o.is_active is true and o.asset_name is not null and nullif(o.source_payload->>'nameId','') is not null
 ), ordinary_candidates as (
  select o.id,ca.coingecko_id,count(ca.coingecko_id) over(partition by o.id) candidate_count
  from public.exchange_asset_observations o join public.crypto_assets ca on upper(ca.symbol)=upper(o.base_symbol) and ca.is_active is true
  where o.is_active is true and o.asset_name is not null
   and (o.exchange<>'kifpool' or not exists(select 1 from kifpool_exact k where k.id=o.id))
   and (
    (
     o.exchange='kifpool'
     and exists (
      select 1 from public.crypto_assets exact_ca
      where upper(exact_ca.symbol)=upper(o.base_symbol) and exact_ca.is_active is true
       and regexp_replace(lower(o.asset_name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')=regexp_replace(lower(exact_ca.name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')
     )
     and regexp_replace(lower(o.asset_name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')=regexp_replace(lower(ca.name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')
    )
    or (
     not (
      o.exchange='kifpool'
      and exists (
       select 1 from public.crypto_assets exact_ca
       where upper(exact_ca.symbol)=upper(o.base_symbol) and exact_ca.is_active is true
        and regexp_replace(lower(o.asset_name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')=regexp_replace(lower(exact_ca.name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')
      )
     )
     and (
      regexp_replace(lower(o.asset_name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')=regexp_replace(lower(ca.name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')
      or (length(regexp_replace(lower(o.asset_name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g'))>=5 and length(regexp_replace(lower(ca.name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g'))>=5
       and (regexp_replace(lower(o.asset_name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g') like '%'||regexp_replace(lower(ca.name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')||'%'
        or regexp_replace(lower(ca.name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g') like '%'||regexp_replace(lower(o.asset_name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')||'%'))
     )
    )
   )
 ), all_candidates as (
  select id,coingecko_id,1::bigint candidate_count from kifpool_exact
  union all select id,coingecko_id,candidate_count from ordinary_candidates
 ), chosen as (
  select id,min(coingecko_id) filter(where candidate_count=1) coingecko_id,max(candidate_count) candidate_count
  from all_candidates group by id
 )
 update public.exchange_asset_observations o set coingecko_id=c.coingecko_id,
  match_status=case when c.candidate_count=1 then 'matched' when c.candidate_count>1 then 'ambiguous' else 'pending' end
 from chosen c where o.id=c.id
  and (
    o.coingecko_id IS DISTINCT FROM c.coingecko_id
    OR o.match_status IS DISTINCT FROM CASE
      WHEN c.candidate_count=1 THEN 'matched'
      WHEN c.candidate_count>1 THEN 'ambiguous'
      ELSE 'pending'
    END
  );
 update public.exchange_asset_observations o set coingecko_id=null,match_status='unmatched'
 where o.is_active is true and o.asset_name is not null
  and not exists(select 1 from public.crypto_assets ca where upper(ca.symbol)=upper(o.base_symbol) and ca.is_active is true)
  and not (o.exchange='kifpool' and exists(
   select 1 from public.crypto_assets ca
   where ca.coingecko_id=o.source_payload->>'nameId' and ca.is_active is true
    and regexp_replace(lower(o.asset_name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')=regexp_replace(lower(ca.name),'[^a-z0-9]','','g')
  ))
  and (o.coingecko_id IS NOT NULL OR o.match_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'unmatched');
 return jsonb_build_object('processed_requests',v_processed,'upserted_rows',v_ingested);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recover_stale_crypto_assets_sync()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_retry_page integer;
BEGIN
  PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(20261108, 500);

  SELECT min(q.page_number)
    INTO v_retry_page
  FROM private.crypto_assets_sync_requests AS q
  LEFT JOIN net._http_response AS h
    ON h.id = q.request_id
  WHERE h.id IS NULL
    AND q.queued_at < pg_catalog.now() - interval '2 minutes'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM net.http_request_queue nq WHERE nq.id = q.request_id
    );

  DELETE FROM private.crypto_assets_sync_requests AS q
  WHERE q.queued_at < pg_catalog.now() - interval '2 minutes'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM net._http_response AS h
      WHERE h.id = q.request_id
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM net.http_request_queue nq WHERE nq.id = q.request_id
    );

  IF v_retry_page IS NOT NULL THEN
    UPDATE private.crypto_assets_sync_state
       SET next_page = CASE WHEN next_page < v_retry_page THEN next_page ELSE v_retry_page END,
           scan_complete = false,
           updated_at = pg_catalog.now()
     WHERE singleton = true;
  END IF;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_crypto_assets()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
    r RECORD;
    v_page INTEGER;
    v_request_id BIGINT;
    v_payload JSONB;
    v_usd_irt NUMERIC;
    v_array_count INTEGER;
    v_pending BOOLEAN := FALSE;
    v_retry_page INTEGER := NULL;
    v_next_page INTEGER;
    v_scan_complete BOOLEAN;
    v_last_sync TIMESTAMPTZ;
BEGIN
    PERFORM pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(20261108, 500);

    SELECT price_toman
    INTO v_usd_irt
    FROM public.market_fx_rates
    WHERE symbol = 'USD_IRT'
      AND is_stale = FALSE
      AND updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
    LIMIT 1;

    FOR r IN
        SELECT
            q.request_id,
            q.page_number,
            h.status_code,
            h.content,
            h.timed_out,
            h.error_msg
        FROM private.crypto_assets_sync_requests q
        LEFT JOIN net._http_response h
            ON h.id = q.request_id
        ORDER BY q.page_number
    LOOP
        IF r.status_code IS NULL THEN
            v_pending := TRUE;
            CONTINUE;
        END IF;

        IF r.status_code = 200
           AND COALESCE(r.timed_out, FALSE) = FALSE
           AND r.content IS NOT NULL THEN

            BEGIN
                v_payload := r.content::JSONB;

                IF pg_catalog.jsonb_typeof(v_payload) <> 'array' THEN
                    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Invalid CoinGecko response';
                END IF;

                v_array_count :=
                    pg_catalog.jsonb_array_length(v_payload);

                INSERT INTO public.crypto_assets (
                    coingecko_id,
                    symbol,
                    name,
                    image_url,
                    market_cap_rank,
                    current_price_usd,
                    price_toman,
                    price_change_percentage_24h,
                    market_cap_usd,
                    total_volume_usd,
                    last_updated,
                    is_active,
                    updated_at
                )
                SELECT
                    x.item ->> 'id',
                    UPPER(x.item ->> 'symbol'),
                    x.item ->> 'name',
                    x.item ->> 'image',

                    CASE
                        WHEN x.item ->> 'market_cap_rank'
                             ~ '^[0-9]+$'
                        THEN (x.item ->> 'market_cap_rank')::INTEGER
                    END,

                    CASE
                        WHEN x.item ->> 'current_price'
                             ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
                        THEN (x.item ->> 'current_price')::NUMERIC
                    END,

                    CASE
                        WHEN v_usd_irt IS NOT NULL
                         AND x.item ->> 'current_price'
                             ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
                        THEN ROUND(
                            (x.item ->> 'current_price')::NUMERIC
                            * v_usd_irt,
                            2
                        )
                    END,

                    CASE
                        WHEN x.item ->> 'price_change_percentage_24h'
                             ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
                        THEN (x.item ->> 'price_change_percentage_24h')::NUMERIC
                    END,

                    CASE
                        WHEN x.item ->> 'market_cap'
                             ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
                        THEN (x.item ->> 'market_cap')::NUMERIC
                    END,

                    CASE
                        WHEN x.item ->> 'total_volume'
                             ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
                        THEN (x.item ->> 'total_volume')::NUMERIC
                    END,

                    NULLIF(x.item ->> 'last_updated', '')::TIMESTAMPTZ,
                    TRUE,
                    NOW()

                FROM pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(v_payload)
                    AS x(item)

                WHERE NULLIF(x.item ->> 'id', '') IS NOT NULL
                  AND NULLIF(x.item ->> 'symbol', '') IS NOT NULL
                  AND NULLIF(x.item ->> 'name', '') IS NOT NULL
                  AND x.item ->> 'current_price'
                      ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
                  AND (x.item ->> 'current_price')::NUMERIC > 0

                ON CONFLICT (coingecko_id)
                DO UPDATE SET
                    symbol = EXCLUDED.symbol,
                    name = EXCLUDED.name,
                    image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url,
                    market_cap_rank = EXCLUDED.market_cap_rank,
                    current_price_usd = EXCLUDED.current_price_usd,
                    price_toman = COALESCE(
                        EXCLUDED.price_toman,
                        public.crypto_assets.price_toman
                    ),
                    price_change_percentage_24h =
                        EXCLUDED.price_change_percentage_24h,
                    market_cap_usd = EXCLUDED.market_cap_usd,
                    total_volume_usd = EXCLUDED.total_volume_usd,
                    last_updated = EXCLUDED.last_updated,
                    is_active = TRUE,
                    updated_at = NOW();

                IF v_array_count < 250 THEN
                    UPDATE private.crypto_assets_sync_state
                    SET
                        scan_complete = TRUE,
                        last_full_sync_at = NOW(),
                        updated_at = NOW()
                    WHERE singleton = TRUE;
                ELSE
                    UPDATE private.crypto_assets_sync_state
                    SET
                        next_page = GREATEST(
                            next_page,
                            r.page_number + 1
                        ),
                        scan_complete = FALSE,
                        updated_at = NOW()
                    WHERE singleton = TRUE;
                END IF;

            EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
                RAISE WARNING
                    'Page % processing failed: %',
                    r.page_number,
                    SQLERRM;

                v_retry_page := LEAST(
                    COALESCE(v_retry_page, r.page_number),
                    r.page_number
                );
            END;

        ELSE
            RAISE WARNING
                'Page % HTTP error: %, %',
                r.page_number,
                r.status_code,
                r.error_msg;

            v_retry_page := LEAST(
                COALESCE(v_retry_page, r.page_number),
                r.page_number
            );
        END IF;

        DELETE FROM private.crypto_assets_sync_requests
        WHERE request_id = r.request_id;
    END LOOP;

    IF v_retry_page IS NOT NULL THEN
        UPDATE private.crypto_assets_sync_state
        SET
            next_page = v_retry_page,
            scan_complete = FALSE,
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE singleton = TRUE;
    END IF;

    IF NOT v_pending
       AND NOT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
           FROM private.crypto_assets_sync_requests
       ) THEN

        SELECT
            next_page,
            scan_complete,
            last_full_sync_at
        INTO
            v_next_page,
            v_scan_complete,
            v_last_sync
        FROM private.crypto_assets_sync_state
        WHERE singleton = TRUE;

        IF v_scan_complete
           AND (
               v_last_sync IS NULL
               OR v_last_sync < NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day'
           ) THEN

            UPDATE private.crypto_assets_sync_state
            SET
                next_page = 1,
                scan_complete = FALSE,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE singleton = TRUE;

            v_next_page := 1;
            v_scan_complete := FALSE;
        END IF;

        IF NOT v_scan_complete THEN
            v_request_id := net.http_get(
                url :=
                    'https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/coins/markets'
                    || '?vs_currency=usd'
                    || '&order=market_cap_desc'
                    || '&per_page=250'
                    || '&page=' || v_next_page::TEXT
                    || '&sparkline=false'
                    || '&price_change_percentage=24h',
                timeout_milliseconds := 20000
            );

            INSERT INTO private.crypto_assets_sync_requests (
                request_id,
                page_number
            )
            VALUES (
                v_request_id,
                v_next_page
            )
            ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING;
        END IF;
    END IF;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_crypto_assets_toman()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
    UPDATE public.crypto_assets AS ca
    SET price_toman = ROUND(
        ca.current_price_usd * fx.price_toman,
        2
    )
    FROM public.market_fx_rates AS fx
    WHERE fx.symbol = 'USD_IRT'
      AND fx.is_stale = FALSE
      AND fx.updated_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
      AND ca.current_price_usd IS NOT NULL
      AND ca.price_toman IS DISTINCT FROM ROUND(
          ca.current_price_usd * fx.price_toman,
          2
      );
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_market_fx_rate()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    r RECORD;
    v_item JSONB;
    v_price NUMERIC;
    v_updated TIMESTAMPTZ;
    v_request_id BIGINT;
BEGIN
    -- پردازش پاسخ‌های دریافت‌شده
    FOR r IN
        SELECT
            q.request_id,
            resp.status_code,
            resp.timed_out,
            resp.error_msg,
            resp.content
        FROM private.market_fx_sync_requests q
        JOIN net._http_response resp
          ON resp.id = q.request_id
        WHERE q.processed_at IS NULL
    LOOP
        BEGIN
            IF r.status_code = 200
               AND r.timed_out = FALSE
               AND r.error_msg IS NULL
               AND r.content IS NOT NULL
            THEN
                v_item := (r.content::JSONB)->'item';

                IF v_item->>'id' = 'usd'
                   AND v_item->>'unit' = 'IRT'
                   AND v_item->>'stale' = 'false'
                   AND NULLIF(v_item->>'price', '') IS NOT NULL
                   AND NULLIF(v_item->>'updated_utc', '') IS NOT NULL
                THEN
                    v_price := (v_item->>'price')::NUMERIC;

                    v_updated :=
                        (v_item->>'updated_utc')::TIMESTAMP
                        AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';

                    IF v_price > 0
                       AND v_updated <= NOW() + INTERVAL '2 minutes'
                       AND v_updated >= NOW() - INTERVAL '20 minutes'
                    THEN
                        INSERT INTO public.market_fx_rates (
                            symbol,
                            price_toman,
                            source,
                            updated_at,
                            source_updated_at,
                            is_stale
                        )
                        VALUES (
                            'USD_IRT',
                            v_price,
                            'NerkhAra',
                            NOW(),
                            v_updated,
                            FALSE
                        )
                        ON CONFLICT (symbol)
                        DO UPDATE SET
                            price_toman = EXCLUDED.price_toman,
                            source = EXCLUDED.source,
                            updated_at = NOW(),
                            source_updated_at = EXCLUDED.source_updated_at,
                            is_stale = FALSE
                        WHERE
                            public.market_fx_rates.source_updated_at IS NULL
                            OR EXCLUDED.source_updated_at >=
                               public.market_fx_rates.source_updated_at;
                    END IF;
                END IF;
            END IF;

            UPDATE private.market_fx_sync_requests
            SET processed_at = NOW()
            WHERE request_id = r.request_id;

        EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
            UPDATE private.market_fx_sync_requests
            SET processed_at = NOW()
            WHERE request_id = r.request_id;
        END;
    END LOOP;

    -- Retry only when a request has genuinely disappeared from
    -- both pg_net tables; never orphan a request that is still queued.
    DELETE FROM private.market_fx_sync_requests q
    WHERE q.processed_at IS NULL
      AND q.queued_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM net.http_request_queue nq WHERE nq.id = q.request_id)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM net._http_response h WHERE h.id = q.request_id);

    -- اگر نرخ بیش از ۲۰ دقیقه قدیمی شد، آن را کهنه علامت بزن
    UPDATE public.market_fx_rates
    SET is_stale = TRUE
    WHERE symbol = 'USD_IRT'
      AND source_updated_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '20 minutes';

    -- ارسال درخواست جدید هر ۱۰ دقیقه
    IF NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM private.market_fx_sync_state
        WHERE id = TRUE
          AND last_requested_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes'
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM private.market_fx_sync_requests q
        WHERE q.processed_at IS NULL
    )
    THEN
        v_request_id := net.http_get(
            url := 'https://nerkhara.com/api/v1/latest/usd.json',
            timeout_milliseconds := 10000
        );

        INSERT INTO private.market_fx_sync_requests (request_id)
        VALUES (v_request_id)
        ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING;

        UPDATE private.market_fx_sync_state
        SET last_requested_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = TRUE;
    END IF;
END;
$function$
